chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
Bargain with the buyer, for it is more satisfying to the soul. Even if he gives generously, the one who is cheated in his selling and buying is neither praiseworthy nor rewarded.

key_terms.الْمَغْبُونَ: One who has been cheated or made to suffer a loss in trade
key_terms.مَاكِسِ: Bargain or negotiate in the transaction

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام teach about bargaining and being cheated in trade?
ai.summary: Imām Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام teaches proper etiquette in trade by encouraging bargaining so that both sides feel inward satisfaction and fairness. The hadith discourages allowing oneself to be unfairly cheated in transactions, indicating that negligence in buying and selling is not something praised or rewarded.
